b) Reference: cherry tomatoes (3 cm) are about 3 across in the cluster, and the olives are about 2.2 cm. The plate's width spans roughly 9-10 cherry tomato lengths... more precisely, the plate edge-to-edge spans about 9 olive-widths of the olive row plus gap, which gives roughly 22-24 cm.
